benchmarks.catalogBaselineMethod: Average cost deflection across 15 general catalog domains vs GPT-4o (measured in routingEval.test.js)
benchmarks.mlV1HoldoutAccuracyMethod: In-sample/tuned holdout accuracy across 27 prompts in routingEvalML.test.js — WARNING: in-sample, not zero-shot
benchmarks.mlV2ZeroShotAccuracyMethod: v3 lexical feature baseline zero-shot out-of-sample accuracy across un-mined prompts in routingEvalBlindV2.test.js
benchmarks.v4SemanticZeroShotAccuracyStatus: VERIFIED — measured on 50-prompt Blind Set V2 using native Node ESM execution to bypass Jest CJS transforms, proving real ONNX semantic similarity via all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
benchmarks.v4SemanticTargetMethod: ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-dim dense vector cosine similarity vs 15-domain k-means (k=3) sub-centroids with calibrated Softmax (tau=0.50) and OOD gating (theta_ood=0.25). Target enforced when test detects fallback=false.
benchmarks.mlV2HoldoutSavingsMethod: Actual cost savings vs always-calling-GPT-4o baseline ($0.020763 vs $0.192813) on 28 un-mined prompts
benchmarks.v4WarmInferenceLatencyNote: Measured natively using ONNX WASM execution (not synthetic fallback).
benchmarks.v4ServerlessColdStartNote: Estimated cold start for WASM initialization. Needs production measurement.
